domain: Is Omega42 a Theory of Everything? The honest answer is that we don't know. Yet. If it is, then it is a very unusual TOE. Let's start from square one and define what "everything" is. In Omega42 logic everything that ever happened has been recorded and that knowledge is contained inside the training data of an AI. It sources the raw building blocks of its responses from these AI training data. It doesn't say that it's Synthesis is true in the traditional sense. It merely states that it is coherent and congruent with the underlying mathematical formula. The Striker must decide what it means. It follows that once "enough" responses has accumulated that a certain picture will emerge. A picture of what "Everything" might be like. So, in that sense, Omega42 might reveal a TOE over time.
